## Re-syncing

The vendored copy is byte-identical to upstream. **Re-syncing happens in the source
repository** (<https://github.com/kterto/my-skills>), not in this installed
distribution — the copy you are reading is generated by
`scripts/build-prime-agent.mjs` and any edit to it is overwritten by the next
build. In a checkout of that repository:

```bash
npx @tech-leads-club/agent-skills install --skill spec-driven-eval
cp -R "$(pwd)/.claude/skills/spec-driven-eval/SKILL.md" \
      "$(pwd)/.claude/skills/spec-driven-eval/references" \
      plugins/my-skills/skills/spec-driven-eval/
# .skill-meta.json is installer bookkeeping — do not vendor it.
node scripts/generate-opencode-skill-index.mjs
node scripts/build-prime-agent.mjs
```

Then bump the version and date in the table above, and reinstall this
distribution with `prime-agent/install.sh`. The CC-BY-4.0 attribution above
survives every re-sync — it is load-bearing in this distribution exactly as it is
upstream.
